decision_rule: Build-only prerequisite using four claimed CPU cores and no GPU. Publisher smoke must compile the actual C5 gated_delta_net.cu HIP object for gfx90a and return a content-bound native compile receipt within 300 seconds. A granted full row configures and builds patched C5 test-backend-ops plus libggml-hip, runs static ggml linkage verification, and writes SHA-256 bindings for source overlay, HIP object, executable, libraries, recipe, and CMake cache. No test binary execution, native op, inference, AutoKernel runtime, performance claim, serving, production edit, or AKX-ALL-31.GDN completion claim. Successor repairs the invalid BF16 registration/comment boundary and binds smoke to its own source tree; original failure retained in prior-failure/. Full build explicitly targets test-backend-ops and ggml-hip. Publisher must first syntax-compile the corrected test-backend-ops.cpp translation unit with the preserved actual CMake-configured C++ flags; native receipt is emitted only after both C++ syntax and HIP-object compilation pass.
